summary: Hold. Not on master (no s7 module; full verify at B>1 still runs paired FA3 at 164/304 us), but s6's own DIAG (archive full-verify-wgmma-s6-split-ring-2cta/4899ab49d74f4df7.log) already answers it: subtracting the measured ticket epilogue (156/107/64 us at B=8/16/32) from the s5-ring full kernel gives a no-ticket kernel of ~179/367 us at B=16/32; pre-attn + kernel + combine projects to ~0.87x / 0.80x of the FA3 route, so it cannot clear the 1.05x gate. A win would port mechanically to muse_decode_layer's full verify rows; none is expected.
justification: s6 DIAG: s5-ring full kernel v2 234.7/285.7/431.4 us at B=8/16/32; gather-only + ticket epilogue (v3) 198.3/188.7/236.7; gather-only, no epilogue (v4) 42.6/81.9/172.5. The ticket epilogue (v3-v4) is 155.7/106.8/64.2 us and falls with B (not B-independent as the hypothesis assumes); v2 minus it gives ~79/179/367 us. The hypothesis reads v2's fit intercept (162.6 us) as the ticket cost and expects ~132/266 us, which would need the ticket to cost 1.28x / 2.4x more in the full kernel than in its gather-only twin. Incumbent (bfb0457c profile): FA3 main 148.6/285.9 + FlashAttnFwdCombine 6.4/6.8 + prepare 3.0/3.4 + pre-attn 2.7/4.1 + norm-gate 2.6/3.8 us; s7 route projects 188-192 us (0.87x) at B=16 and 378-381 us (0.80x) at B=32. The gap is the main loop (compute adds ~1.3 us per tile per CTA at 2 CTAs/SM over a 1.15 us/tile gather), not the merge. Closer prior not cited: full-verify-cuda-streamk-splitkv (regression 1.2314x) lost in its main loop. Secondary risk: a third load_inline module on s6's tight import clock.
confounders: fa3-hdim128-head-pairing / paired-heads-launch-cleanup (+ ab-tune) define the incumbent; the gate times route vs route in one process and the incumbent is the same on both bases, so no confound.
fused-preattention-triton is shared by both routes, so no confound.
The s6 base predates everything landed after 10-25, so the headline cannot be compared with the 1.634 board; a routed result would still need a restack check onto current master.
interference: No companions: nothing landed is entangled with the full-verify B>1 route, and the hypothesis's own DIAG rows already isolate its two sub-changes.
open_questions: If the direct number is still wanted: one DIAG-only w6_kernel instantiation (RING=0, 4 stages, MINB 2, full compute, EPI off / STORE_ONLY) in the next full-verify stage settles additivity at no check cost (prediction ~179/367 us at B=16/32).
The next full-verify stage should target the main loop (gather alone 1.29x / 1.36x floor at 81.9/172.5 us; FA3 main 148.6/285.9 us), with STORE_ONLY + combine as its epilogue from the start.

Port to muse_decode_layer: mechanical (S3 c3 cells run the same paired FA3 + combine + norm-gate on the same geometry; FA3 main is 151.9 us of the 466.96 us verify_16 row and 288.2 us of the 700.90 us verify_32 row in 9afcccc3), needing its own in-file gate.
